title: Contents Packout & Storage Return Truck Line: Loads and Amount
content:
**Calculation clause.** The standard return truck line is one load for each vault recorded on the job, at the tier's truck trip fee, rounded to the cent, half up.

This Contents Packout & Storage clause prices the move-back truck line that brings home the contents of a Partial Contents Packout, Full Contents Packout, High-Value Contents Packout or Commercial Contents and Records Recovery job. For the move-back truck line of a return, and only for that line, the amount is figured as stated here; every packout, cleaning or disposal line amount is still quantity times unit rate.

## Inputs

- The vault count recorded on the job (vaults filled at custody start, as later added or consolidated).
- The tier's truck trip fee (schedule of labor, trip, report and disposal charges).

## How the amounts combine

The amounts are combined in one order: the rate per load is the tier's truck trip fee with any percentage applied first, then any factor multiplying that result, then every add per load added; that rate per load is multiplied by the return loads; any amount figured per item is added to that product, and the total is rounded once to the cent, half up, as the line amount. Half up is applied with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before rounding, so that a figure lying on a half cent always rounds up.

**Worked figure (hypothetical).** A job recording 4 vaults, at a trip fee taken as 100.00 for the illustration (not a tier figure): 4 loads times 100.00 is 400.00.
